note: Reviewed map from changed files to desktop specs, used by e2e/select-specs.mjs and verify:fast. Order of evaluation: broad, noDesktop, desktop specs and helpers (by name and import graph), areas, then unknown (broad). A file is narrowed only by a rule here. Add an area only after reading what its specs exercise; keep native and shared files broad unless a rule says otherwise. Baseline: the git ref passed as --since (default HEAD).
